title: Current xdrip watchfaces do not support sound
symptom: The xDrip watch faces do not support sound alerts on Android Wear 2.0 watches that have a speaker, so users still need a phone for sound alerts because watch vibration is weak.
fix: Enable the on-watch notifications and the sound feature via xDrip preferences on the watch face, after installing the latest wear app from the Aug 19th Nightly.
evidence_quote: Then you need to enable the on-watch notifications and the sound feature - both via xDrip preferences on the watch face.
